reward_terms.name: progress
reward_terms.description: Potential difference towards world target (1000,0,0). __call__ zeros target-vector z before distance; reset uses initial 3-D distance. Potential=-distance/control_dt, then manager multiplies by dt. No separate linear-velocity reward.

reward_terms.name: alive
reward_terms.description: (~termination_manager.terminated).float(): 1 for non-fall steps including pure timeout; 0 on non-timeout termination, including simultaneous fall+timeout.

reward_terms.name: move_to_target
reward_terms.description: Heading projection towards target: 1 if projection > 0.8, else projection/0.8 (may be negative).

reward_terms.name: energy
reward_terms.description: sum(abs(action * joint_velocity * normalized_gear_ratio)); all gear ratios 15, normalized by maximum => 1. This is the stock proxy, not a new physical energy measurement.

reward_terms.name: joint_pos_limits
reward_terms.description: Normalize joints to [-1,1] using soft limits; sum (abs(normalized_position)>0.99) * (abs(position)-0.99)/(1-0.99) * normalized_gear_ratio.

reward_definition.total: Authoritative unchanged env.step returned reward; no replacement/redefinition
reward_definition.manager: compute evaluates raw term once, multiplies weight * control_dt, sequentially adds float32 values
reward_definition.buffer: _step_reward stores weighted per-second value: value/control_dt, not raw/unweighted. Logging restores control_dt without recomputing terms.
reward_definition.extras: reset logging averages over resetting envs and divides episode component sums by max episode length seconds; not sufficient per-env episode data
reward_definition.terminal: All seven terms evaluated after termination computation and before auto-reset; alive zero on terminated step, pure timeout alive remains one
reward_definition.no: No explicit terminal penalty, standalone linear-velocity reward or new reward component

bootstrap.method: paired env_id block percentile 95%, shared multinomial resamples across policies/components/measures
bootstrap.multiple_comparisons: Marginal exploratory component CIs; no p-values, no multiplicity correction

definitions.pre40: Steps 1..first_reach_step_40m inclusive; entire episode if unreached
definitions.post40: Strictly after first reach through terminal step; zero for noncompleters
definitions.per_step: Per-episode component_sum / own episode_steps, then equal-env average; not a pooled exposure-weighted rate
definitions.fractions: Ratio of mean component to mean env total; supplementary signed ratio, not a share of positive utility
definitions.duration_rate_identity: delta(S)=delta(L)*(q_new+q_ref)/2 + delta(q)*(L_new+L_ref)/2. This is symmetric algebra, not a causal decomposition.

identity.justification: Eight-or-fewer nominal failures are expected native float32 sequential-accumulation roundoff; actual total trajectory exactly reproduces existing evaluation. Episode tolerance 2e-6 relative + 1e-6 absolute retains all observed errors and every episode also passes the explicit gamma_N roundoff bound.
